fields.title: 📖 First repair the wrong — then increase the dhikr
fields.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī** رحمه الله was asked:

“A man has **acquired 30,000 dirhams wrongfully** and says: I will say tasbīḥ, taḥmīd and takbīr until I have gathered just as many good deeds. What do you say to that?”

He answered:

“**He should return the money first.** For his dhikr will not be accepted until he has returned it.”

🌙 **Conclusion:** **Returning the rights of others** cannot be replaced by additional voluntary acts of worship. Whoever has committed wrong must strive for **restitution**.

immutable.source: 📝 Abū Nuʿaym, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ, Bd. 7, S. 10, Abschnitt über Sufyān aṯ-Ṯawrī.
immutable.book: Abū Nuʿaym al-Iṣfahānī, Ḥilyat al-Awliyāʾ wa-Ṭabaqāt al-Aṣfiyāʾ
